- The Dismissed Genius: Meet Neville Nicholls and John McBride, the meteorologists whose revolutionary research was ignored by the establishment until the devastating Ash Wednesday bushfires proved them right.
- Predicting the Apocalypse: Learn how a simple pressure difference between Tahiti and Darwin became the world’s most powerful tool for climate forecasting.
- Breaking the Models: We explore the modern crisis—why climate change is heating our oceans and causing traditional weather patterns to fracture, leaving even our best scientists guessing.
From human tragedy to cutting-edge atmospheric science, we’re peeling back the curtain on why our modern weather feels so erratic. Is the climate shifting faster than we can track? Or are we losing our ability to forecast the future?
